## Change type

- [ ] code / infrastructure
- [ ] data source or licence finding
- [ ] reproduction or failed reproduction
- [ ] correction to a document or a number
- [ ] Filipino-language expertise (labels, guidelines, error categories)

## Evidence

Describe the tests, sources and revisions. Do not include fabricated or unverified results.

## Checks

- [ ] Every number is recomputed from a committed file, and one quantity has one value everywhere
- [ ] Citations come from `research/papers/references.bib` (added through `seed.json`, never by hand)
- [ ] No dataset rows, held-out sentences, checkpoints, credentials or personal data are added
- [ ] A new decision has an entry in `decisions/DECISIONS.md`
